map.门窗选型：按面积推荐普通/钢化玻璃最小安全厚度: Door and window selection: recommended minimum safe thickness for ordinary and tempered glass by area
map.护栏/隔断：大跨度或安全场景要求钢化/夹胶厚度: Guardrails and partitions: large spans or safety scenarios require tempered or laminated thickness
map.下单依据：结合面积与最大跨度查表，避免偏薄失效: Ordering basis: look up the table by area and maximum span to avoid failures from glass that is too thin
map.算法：面积=宽×高/10⁶ (m²)，最大跨度=max(宽,高) (mm)；按场: Algorithm: area = width × height / 10⁶ (m²), maximum span = max(width, height) (mm); the minimum recommended thickness is looked up by scenario — windows: ≤ 0.8 m² → 3 mm, ≤ 1.5 → 4, ≤ 2.5 → 5, ≤ 3.5 → 6, ≤ 5 → 8, > 5 → ≥ 10 mm; glass doors: span ≤ 900 → 6 mm tempered, ≤ 1800 → 8, ≤ 2400 → 10, > 2400 → 12 mm tempered; shelves, desktops and partitions each have their own brackets. Non-window scenarios default to tempered. Requires dimensions > 0.
map.例1（窗户 800×1200mm）：面积 960000/1e6=0.96m²、跨: Example 1 (window 800 × 1200 mm): area 960000 / 1e6 = 0.96 m², span 1200 mm; 0.96 > 0.8 and ≤ 1.5 → 4 mm ordinary glass is usable. Example 2 (glass door 1500 × 2000 mm): area 3.00 m², span 2000 mm; span ≤ 2400 → 10 mm tempered glass recommended (safety scenarios must use tempered).
map.为什么门窗厚度规则不同？: Why are the thickness rules different for windows and doors?
map.窗户以面积定（风压与挠度随面积增大），普通采光可用普通玻璃；玻璃门/护栏涉及人身: Windows are sized by area (wind pressure and deflection grow with area) and ordinary glass can be used for daylighting; glass doors and guardrails involve personal safety, so they are sized by span and must be tempered or laminated, starting at 6 mm.

map.玻璃厚度选择是一款商业办公领域的在线工具。商业办公工具，提升工作效率，数据本地处: Glass thickness selection is an online tool in the business and office field. Business and office tools improve efficiency, and data is processed locally to protect privacy.

map.本工具只做面积/跨度初筛，不输出“推荐最小厚度”，也不判定普通玻璃是否可用: This tool only screens by area/span; it does not output a recommended minimum thickness or decide whether ordinary glass is acceptable

Windows/daylighting: ordinary annealed glass is only a non-safety daylighting candidate; high-rise, large panels, operable sashes, sloped glazing or locations above traffic require the designer to decide whether tempered/laminated glass is needed. Glass doors, shelves, tabletops, partitions and guardrails: safety glass (tempered or tempered-laminated) is mandatory; ordinary annealed glass is not permitted. Minimum thickness, wind load/deflection, impact, support and anchorage must be verified under JGJ 113, the GB 15763 series and local codes. Requires width and height >0.

The tool reports only area and span and notes that ordinary annealed glass is only a non-safety daylighting candidate; whether it is acceptable and how thick it must be depend on wind load, installation height, support, deflection and local codes, as determined by the designer. It no longer outputs “4 mm ordinary glass is acceptable”. Example 2 (glass door 1500×2000 mm): area 3.00 m², maximum span 2000 mm; glass doors are safety-critical and require tempered or laminated safety glass; leaf thickness and hardware clamping must be verified by the designer, with no “10 mm tempered” conclusion.
map.为什么不再推荐最小厚度？: Why is minimum thickness no longer recommended?
map.原表按面积/跨度给固定档位，没有输入风压、安装高度、支承方式、荷载、挠度和冲击条: The old table assigned fixed thickness bands by area/span without wind load, installation height, support type, structural load, deflection or impact inputs, and had no traceable code calculation. It could not serve as a minimum thickness or compliance conclusion, so it has been withdrawn; only area/span screening remains.
map.普通、钢化、夹胶玻璃怎么区分适用？: How do ordinary, tempered and laminated glass differ in use?
map.普通退火玻璃强度低、破碎为尖锐碎片，只能作为非安全采光候选；钢化玻璃是安全玻璃，: Ordinary annealed glass has low strength and breaks into sharp shards, so it is only a non-safety daylighting candidate. Tempered glass is safety glass that breaks into small granules and is used for doors, shelves and tabletops. Laminated glass holds its fragments with the interlayer after breakage and suits guardrails, skylights and fall protection. The exact type and detailing still require design confirmation.
